evidence_quotes.quote: PH 1000 tube of 10 low-calorie effervescent tablets (60 g net, 6 g per tablet): 1,000 mg sodium, 250 mg potassium, 48 mg calcium, 24 mg magnesium per liter (500 mg Na / 125 mg K / 12 mg Mg per tablet).
Per 1 tablet (500 ml serving): ~16 kcal, 2.2 g carbohydrates (1.0 g sugar), <0.1 g protein, <0.1 g fat; sweetened with sucralose.
NSF Certified for Sport batch-tested effervescent tablets; vegan and gluten-free.

adversarial_checks: Verified per-tablet sodium (500 mg) vs per-liter name (1,000 mg/L); active Na+K = 0.625 g per 6.0 g tablet.
Verified 6.0 g x 10 = 60 g net weight (0.0% deviation) and 0.625 / 6.0 * 100 = 10.42% Na+K purity.
Quantified 40% true-cost premium per 1,000 mg Na+K versus same-priced PH 1500 tube.
Confirmed zero legacy blocklist overlap and SM-05 factual compliance.
